name: Condition Monitoring of Hydraulic Systems
summary: Repeated load cycles from a hydraulic test rig measured by 17 sensors at multiple sampling rates, with condition labels for four components.

feature_dimensions.summary: 17 sensor channels; 43,680 measurements per flattened 60-second cycle
feature_dimensions.counting: Seven channels at 100 Hz contribute 6,000 samples each, two at 10 Hz contribute 600 each, and eight at 1 Hz contribute 60 each. A single-sensor load therefore has 6,000, 600, or 60 columns. The four condition targets and stability flag in profile.txt are excluded.

attributes.name: PS1..PS6
attributes.description: Pressure sensors sampled at 100 Hz, with 6,000 points per cycle.

attributes.name: EPS1
attributes.description: Motor-power sensor sampled at 100 Hz, with 6,000 points per cycle.

attributes.name: FS1..FS2
attributes.description: Volume-flow sensors sampled at 10 Hz, with 600 points per cycle.

attributes.name: TS1..TS4
attributes.description: Temperature sensors sampled at 1 Hz, with 60 points per cycle.

attributes.name: VS1
attributes.description: Vibration sensor sampled at 1 Hz, with 60 points per cycle.

attributes.name: SE
attributes.description: Efficiency factor sampled at 1 Hz, with 60 points per cycle.

attributes.name: CE
attributes.description: Virtual cooling-efficiency sensor sampled at 1 Hz.

attributes.name: CP
attributes.description: Virtual cooling-power sensor sampled at 1 Hz.

attributes.name: valve_condition
attributes.description: Valve switching condition [%], with values 73, 80, 90, and 100.

attributes.name: internal_pump_leakage
attributes.description: Internal pump leakage: 0 none, 1 weak, and 2 severe.

attributes.name: stable_flag
attributes.description: 0 indicates stable conditions; 1 indicates that steady state may not have been reached.

notes: The dataset contains 2,205 labeled 60-second cycles and 17 channels: seven at 100 Hz, two at 10 Hz, and eight at 1 Hz.

There are 43,680 scalar measurements per cycle and 96,314,400 across all cycles. These counts flatten time and channels; the simultaneous channel count is 17, or seven when selecting only the 100 Hz group.
Cycle IDs in the Python API are zero-based (0 through 2204) and match profile rows. Conditions label whole cycles, not within-cycle phase boundaries.
load_cycle returns separate frames keyed by native sampling rate, without interpolation. time_s is constructed as sample/rate; the raw matrices contain no timestamps.
All 17 matrices and profile.txt were validated for shape, finite measurements, target values, and matching cycle counts; no missing values were found.
stable_flag=0 means stable conditions; 1 means that steady state may not have been reached. Stability does not imply healthy components.
VS1 is sampled at 1 Hz. CE and CP are virtual channels; their derived nature matters when interpreting dependence graphs.
citation: Helwig, N., Pignanelli, E. and Schütze, A. (2015). Condition Monitoring of a Complex Hydraulic System Using Multivariate Statistics.
